full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-wash cartoon illustration shows four caricatured men outside a crooked stone cottage, with a few small birds at their feet. Most of the background remains bare off-white paper. A soft pale blue wash fills the upper-left sky, while light tan linework gives the cottage a pitched roof, tall chimney, and small dormer window on the right. Three men stand in a loose row across the left and middle ground. The far-left man faces right in profile, wearing an orange-brown coat and trousers, large shoes, and an improbably tall black top hat. His long nose and pointed chin are drawn with quick black strokes. Beside him stands a broader man in a dark blue jacket and gray trousers, also in side view. His round belly, large hooked nose, and thinning pale hair are exaggerated by loose crosshatching. A slightly shorter man in a plum-dark jacket stands to the right of him, looking left, with the same comic profile and sharp nose. Farther right, an older small figure stoops beside the cottage wall, wearing a gray-brown coat and appearing to lean on a cane or bent arm. Tiny birds or bird-like shapes gather along the uneven ground beneath the standing figures, and another perches near the right-side bushes. A few scratchy strokes suggest weeds, stones, and a low patch of vegetation rather than a fully rendered street. The cottage is reduced to a slanted roof, dark window, rectangular wall, and a few tightly hatched shadows. The men's clothes carry selective washes of ocher, blue, mauve, and gray, while faces stay pale pink with pronounced noses and ears. Thin ink lines wander, overlap, and sometimes leave contours open; energetic hatching gives bodies weight without smoothing away the sketch. Even ambient daylight keeps the paper bright, with only short drawn shadows under feet and along the wall. The overall composition is humorous and lightly balanced, letting an uneven line of characters stand against generous white space and one modest architectural backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形墨线淡彩漫画插画呈现四名漫画化男子站在一座歪斜石屋外，脚边有几只小鸟。背景大部分保留灰白纸面。左上天空铺着柔淡蓝色色洗，浅棕线条在右侧勾出小屋的斜屋顶、高烟囱和小老虎窗。三名男子在左侧与中部松散排成一行。最左男子以侧脸朝右，穿橘褐色外套与长裤、大鞋子，戴一顶高得夸张的黑色礼帽。长鼻和尖下巴由迅速的黑色笔痕画出。旁边站着一名更宽壮的男子，穿深蓝夹克和灰裤，也呈侧身。他的圆肚、弯钩鼻与稀疏浅发被松动交叉排线夸大。稍矮的一名男子穿深梅紫夹克站在其右，朝左看，同样有喜剧化的侧脸与尖鼻。更右边，一位矮小年长人物在小屋墙边弯腰，穿灰褐外套，似乎靠着手杖或弯曲手臂。细小鸟儿或鸟形痕迹聚在站立者脚下不平整地面上，还有一只停在右侧灌木附近。少数刮擦线条暗示杂草、石头和一小片低矮植物，而不是完整绘出的街道。小屋被压缩为倾斜屋顶、深色窗、矩形墙面与几块密排线阴影。人物衣服局部染上赭黄、蓝、灰紫和灰色，脸部保持浅粉，鼻子和耳朵格外突出。纤细墨线游走、重叠，有时还留下开放轮廓；活泼的排线让身体有重量，却没有磨平草稿感。均匀环境日光让纸面明亮，脚下和墙边只有短短绘制阴影。整体构图幽默且轻巧均衡，让不齐整的人物队列站在大量白纸留白和一个简洁建筑背景前。
style_prompt_en: The ink-and-wash illustration is carried by quick, wandering black contours, loose crosshatching, and sparse transparent color. Off-white paper remains a major compositional area, while muted ocher, dusty blue, plum, and warm gray appear only in selected masses. Forms are knowingly distorted through long angles, outsized curves, and uneven proportions, yet gestures remain readable. Hatching supplies dark weight at folds, overlaps, and ground contact, while open linework lets the page breathe. Architectural or environmental structure is sketched economically with tilted straight lines and a few shaded patches. Light is even and paper-based rather than cinematic, so visual rhythm comes from the lively marks and spacing. The overall effect is witty, agile, and deliberately imperfect, with expressive line more important than polished finish.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线淡彩插画由迅速游走的黑轮廓、松散交叉排线与稀疏透明色承担。灰白纸面仍是主要构图区域，低调赭黄、灰蓝、梅紫和暖灰只出现在选定色团里。形体通过长角度、夸大的弧线和不齐整比例有意扭曲，姿态却保持可读。排线在褶皱、重叠与接地处提供深色重量，开放线条让纸面呼吸。空间结构由倾斜直线和少数阴影斑块简练勾出。光均匀而基于纸面，不具电影式效果，视觉节奏来自活泼笔痕与间距。整体效果机智敏捷、刻意不完美，表现性线条比抛光完成度更重要。
theme_en: Four caricatured men and small birds outside a crooked cottage
theme_zh: 歪斜小屋外的四名漫画化男子与几只小鸟
name: Ronald Searle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
